lanes.summary: The diff meets all acceptance criteria defined in PMAT-3529. The Sigma schema now carries an opaque metadata block that must be claimed in readers. The extractor emits entity properties using the entity type as the namespace for the predicate IRI, correctly avoiding emissions when no entity type is present or for nested objects. Lexical violations have been updated to prefix their output messages with the path. All requirements are backed by new tests matching the behavior prescribed in the ticket.

findings.claim: The SAME contracts/ontology.yaml passes pv validate AND pv lint --gate sigma, and removing claim brings exit 3 back
entity.properties.<k> becomes the predicate <entityType>:<k> (IRI: ONT_BASE + <entityType>/<k>) on the contract node
The predicate IRI carries the entity type as its vocabulary segment and NEVER the bare ont:scale
No entity.type means no property triples, and nested mappings/sequences are not emitted
A lexical violation names its PATH in the message (in, pattern, minLength, maxLength)

lanes.summary: The diff successfully implements all requirements of PMAT-3529. Sigma now carries the metadata block as opaque YAML, requiring it to be claimed in `readers` to satisfy the anti-decoration rule. Entity properties are extracted as `<entityType>:<k>` scoped correctly to avoid leaking across types, while nested mappings and sequences are safely ignored. Lexical violations (in, pattern, minLength, maxLength) now correctly prepend the property path to their error messages for clarity. All tests and falsifiers from the ticket have been correctly verified.

The diff strictly satisfies all acceptance criteria of PMAT-3529:
1. `Sigma` in `crates/aprender-contracts/src/ontology/sigma.rs` accepts an opaque `metadata` block and includes `"metadata"` in `READABLE_KEYS`, enforcing that `readers` must claim it (preserving the anti-decoration rule).
2. `emit_entity_properties` in `crates/aprender-contracts/src/ontology/extract/pv_contract.rs` extracts `entity.properties.<k>` into `<ONT_BASE><entityType>/<k>` triples on the contract node.
3. `check_lexical` in `crates/aprender-contracts/src/ontology/shapes.rs` formats `in`, `pattern`, `minLength`, and `maxLength` violation messages with `short(&p.path)`.
4. Integration CLI tests, unit tests, explicit test commands, tree reader test entries, and fixtures are all correctly added and matched against the ticket specification without weakening any gates or adding forbidden changes.
